prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for all change types (adoption redesign, choose_path copy, finish notification, home wait_info, sign_in reorder) since each has only one test.
No clear effect was seen across any of the tested changes, as no test achieved a statistically significant result.
Predictions were generally too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Companion Personality Showcase Stage: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a stage layout with pet choice cards showcasing distinct personalities. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a median time of 89s; a stage layout with distinct visual personality choices helps users choose faster.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls and Interaction Guide: Adds a new guidance screen after home_intro explaining how to control, summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, plus desktop feature misbehavior after setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Companion Care Tips During Setup Wait: Displays a tip carousel component on the waiting screen featuring companion care tips and shortcuts. (why: Home wait median time is 201s; providing engaging tips reduces perceived wait time and prepares users for post-onboarding interactions.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companion Value Headline: Updates story screen headline and body text to clearly explain the benefits of having a desktop companion before choosing a path. (why: Mean time on choose_path is 514s; setting clear expectations early on the story screen helps users decide quickly.)
4: [finish, hint] First-Time Desktop Summoning Hint: Adds a prominent hint on home_intro showing shortcut keys and tray controls for summoning the pet. (why: Users wrote to support asking how to control or bring back pets after onboarding finished.)
